payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what changed, and where is each added frog located relative to the toilet bowl interior, rim, lid, and floor?
node.criteria: Assess the requested addition against the source image. complete: at least one frog not present in the source is visibly placed within the toilet bowl interior (below the rim, not merely on the rim or lid). partial: a frog was added but none is clearly within the bowl interior, or placement there is only partial/ambiguous. absent: no frog was added. unknown: image evidence is insufficient to compare or determine placement. Record locations distinctly; frogs on the lid, rim, or floor do not count as inside the bowl, and additional frogs do not by themselves change fulfillment.
node.binding: The toilet bowl interior and surrounding rim/lid/floor, comparing the source and edited images for added frogs.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"Compared with the source, four frogs are added: one is clearly inside the bowl below the rim; one is on the raised lid, one is on the rear rim/tank area, and one is on the floor beside the toilet.
